description: This file defines a final class 'SimpleFileWatcher' that provides a simple interface for starting and stopping a file system watcher, wrapping around an internal 'CoalescingFSEventsWatcher' instance.

classes.name: SimpleFileWatcher
classes.description: A lightweight wrapper class for managing a file system event watcher, providing start and stop functionalities.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the watcher with a 'CoalescingFSEventsWatcher' instance.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Ensures the watcher is stopped when the object is deallocated.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the file system event watcher.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the file system event watcher.
